cases.case_label: Ancestral SVA insertion-mediated homozygous deletion of WDR66 penultimate exons
cases.disease: Multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagellum (MMAF), male infertility
cases.mechanism_detail: Seven MMAF men carry a homozygous deletion removing the two penultimate exons of WDR66, with a single chimeric SVA at the breakpoint in all, suggesting an ancestral SVA insertion followed by recombination generated the deletion.
cases.quote: suggesting that the initial deletion event was potentially mediated by an SVA insertion-recombination mechanism
